lines.2: Black hair flowing in the wind.
lines.4: How had a beauty like that been at our school all this time?
lines.5: Though I felt as if I'd seen her somewhere before.
lines.6: For a moment, our eyes met.
lines.7: But she turned away again as if she had no interest.
lines.8: What was she looking at? The sun?
lines.12: 「That's the woman who wrecked the curry shop... She goes to our school.」
lines.13: 「Oh, right. From Oasis, the curry place, a week ago.」
lines.14: So that was where I'd seen her.
lines.15: 「I don't like her, but finding out she goes here too... This could get fun.」
lines.17: 「As her senior, I feel like teaching her a few things.」
lines.18: 「But she's a first-year? She's got an awful lot of presence for one, doesn't she?」
lines.19: 「All right, decided. We're recruiting her for the student council.」
lines.20: 「Hey, are you out of your mind?」
lines.21: 「She's a first-year, she's gorgeous, and it looks like she's got big boobs.」
lines.23: 「God just whispered to me: choose this girl!」
lines.27: 「Doesn't she seem to be giving off an 'I'm lonely, somebody hold me' beam?」
lines.28: 「Really? I see the opposite--a 'stay away from me' aura.」
